summary_1line: Amba gains Shiva’s promise to destroy Bhishma, self‑immolates, and is reborn as Drupada’s child Sikhandin, secretly raised as a son.

image_candidates.scene_text: The maiden Amba stands before Shiva bearing the trident among gathered sages as he promises she will one day slay Bhishma.
On the banks of the Yamuna, Amba ignites a towering funeral pyre and walks into the flames declaring Bhishma’s destruction.
Drupada and his queen secretly present their newborn daughter as a son while court rituals for a prince are performed.
